derived_from: C26 exact generation prompt and C25 exact editorial operations
proxy_delivery: One whole-story Terra author. First request composes a passage saved as NN.draft.md, not delivered to player. A separate fixed editorial request revises that draft and saves NN.story.md. Both requests see the same full story context; only the revised passage would reach a player. No per-character agents or separate reviewer supplies story content. Coding-agent tool round trips remain a proxy limitation.
change: Test an explicit second request to the same author using the successful C25 structural-redraft task. C26 generation instructions and complete Covenant remain unchanged. No character examples or reduced backstories. This is a sequential two-request loop, not evidence of one-request latency or cost.
planned_scope: One matched game screen initially; preserve draft, revision and exact requests.
